arguments.objective:
Verify the complete live Coding RALPH dashboard already present in this workspace. This is a separate Custom Coding RALPH verification run with Bedrock Haiku 4.5. The seeded application passed the full HTTP, SSE, Chromium, and held-out suite in the previous run, but that run's test Child ended with a plain text response instead of the required structured result, so the controller correctly reported blocked. Do not make cosmetic changes. Repair code only if the frozen tests reveal a real failure.

The implementation Child should inspect the existing code and contract, then submit `{status:"ready",summary:"..."}` through `structured_output` if the app is ready. The independent test Child must run exactly `node --test --test-reporter=tap acceptance/live-ui.test.mjs acceptance/live-ui.browser.test.mjs` once, inspect its actual output, and submit `{status:"pass",summary:"..."}` through `structured_output` only if every test passes. Include actual test count and exit code. Use fail for assertion failures and blocked for infrastructure errors. A natural-language final message without the tool submission is invalid. The Custom host repeats the frozen suites and then runs the held-out suite. Use at most eight fresh rounds; finish only with verified completion.
